title: Across France
intro: The journey leaves Courmayeur and crosses beneath the Mont Blanc massif into France. From the Alps, the route continues north across eastern France toward Strasbourg, trading high mountain scenery for the historic streets and canals of Alsace.

stops.name: Courmayeur
stops.description: Leave Courmayeur after two nights beneath Mont Blanc and begin the journey into France.

stops.name: Mont Blanc Tunnel
stops.description: Cross beneath the Mont Blanc massif from Italy into France.

stops.name: Strasbourg
stops.description: Arrive in Strasbourg and settle in for the night in the heart of Alsace.
